ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the macro-surface with localized high-intensity (white) clusters at distal tips; estimated white-to-black pixel ratio is approximately 1:15.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a contiguous low-intensity black field. High-contrast white geometric clusters are localized at the distal tips. A distinct, isolated circular high-intensity ring is visible in the upper-medial region of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow U-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 140-150 degrees; vertical depth from lobe crests is approximately 5% of total fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 12 pixels with higher frequency of micro-valleys on the medial portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a linear-to-slightly-convex trajectory sweeping upwards from the median notch toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-intensity pixel groups located exclusively on the extreme lateral tips of the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, including one distinct vertical mark approximately midway between the notch and the right tip.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, high-contrast circular ring-shaped scar is located in the upper mid-section of the left lobe's ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy calcareous encrustations (barnacles) creating a jagged, high-texture silhouette on the distal lobe tips.
